documents.text: Python is a popular programming language used for web development, automation, data science, and machine learning.
A Python virtual environment isolates project dependencies so different applications can use different package versions.
Large language models generate text by predicting tokens based on patterns learned from massive training datasets.
Embedding models convert text into numerical vectors that can be compared using cosine similarity.
Semantic search retrieves documents based on meaning rather than exact keyword matching.
Vector databases store embeddings and allow efficient nearest-neighbor search over large document collections.
Sourdough bread is made using a fermented starter that gives the loaf a tangy flavor and chewy texture.
Tomato soup pairs well with grilled cheese sandwiches, especially on a cold day.
Mars is often called the red planet because iron oxide on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.
A telescope collects light from distant objects and helps astronomers observe stars, planets, and galaxies.
A piano produces sound when hammers strike strings inside the instrument.
Jazz music often includes improvisation, syncopated rhythms, and extended harmonies.
